mapper.select: SELECT tm.menu_nm AS menuName, tm.mid_nm AS category, o.personal_option AS personalOption, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders o INNER JOIN twosome_menu tm ON o.twosome_menu_id = tm.id WHERE o.order_date = #{orderDate} AND o.del_yn = 'N' GROUP BY tm.menu_nm, tm.mid_nm, o.personal_option ORDER BY tm.mid_nm, tm.menu_nm
